title: Recovery of False SkillsFuture Credit Claims
what_it_is: Recovery of False SkillsFuture Credit Claims

sections.label: SSG recovery from false claims
sections.summary: SSG has demanded repayment from individuals who gave false information, who acted alone and face fines or imprisonment under the SSG Agency Act.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG) has since issued letters to these individuals to demand for the monies to be repaid.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: As these individuals have up to early April to make payment, it is premature to look at the monies recovered as of now.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Our investigations show that these individuals acted on their own accord and did not conspire with any training provider.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Individuals who provide false information to SSG are in breach of section 58 of the SkillsFuture Singapore Agency Act.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: This carries a maximum penalty of a $10,000 fine and/or imprisonment of up to 12 months.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Members can be sure that SSG is tracking the recovery of monies closely and will not hesitate to take necessary actions, including legal measures, against those who fail to return the monies.

sections.label: SSG checks and review committee
sections.summary: SSG is increasing checks and audits on training providers and individual claims, and a process review committee of SSG board members has been set up.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: For example, SSG is intensifying its scope and frequency of checks and audits on training providers as well as individual claims.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: In addition, a process review committee comprising the SSG board members has been set up.
